flagged.title: Tawhid, the Nature of Allah & Angels
flagged.reason: The video presents an inaccurate, unpublished translation of Surah 112 ('None is born of him, he is unborn') and instructs students to memorize it, teaching a flawed quotation for the only scripture explicitly named on the specification.

mark_affecting.quote: He is Allah, the One. Allah is Eternal and Absolute. None is born of him, he is unborn. There is none like unto him.
